annotations.title: Open a saved green slip result

description: Open a saved NSW green slip price comparison from greenslips.com.au (or compare_ctp_prices) by its Greenslips reference - the 8-character code shown with a result and at the end of its link (calculator.html?load-result=...). Use it when someone gives a reference or a result link, to see those prices again, buy or ask about them. It returns the prices as they were calculated, with that date, each insurer's link and the full result link - not today's prices: for those, compare again with compare_ctp_prices.

reference.description: The Greenslips reference, e.g. yLrJLjfc - or the whole result link, which ends with it
